integrity: The uncorrelated-noise stationary covariance is known prior work; the claimed new contribution is only the complete sharp positive-autocorrelation momentum-benefit classification. Equivalence to unlocated older specialized results cannot be excluded. Proof uses analytic identities with supplementary finite exact-rational checks.
limitations: Exact for scalar strongly convex quadratics, fixed stepsizes and state-independent stationary positive-AR(1) noise of finite variance only. No multidimensional or nonlinear conclusion or global rate optimality.
title: A sharp momentum-benefit frontier under persistent gradient noise
